XIAN: An administrative subdivision of imperial, republican, and communist China roughly equivalent to counties, now distingui
XIANG: A Chinese language spoken mainly in Hunan province, China
XIANGQI: Chinese chess; a board game similar to chess, invented and traditionally played in China.
XIAOLONGBAO: A type of dumpling or steamed bun (baozi) associated with eastern China, particularly Nanxiang near Shanghai.
XING: Abbreviation of crossing or pedestrian crossing.
XINHUA: A district of Shijiazhuang, Hebei, China.
